description: This file defines a PHP class named ECB that extends a system controller, implementing currency exchange rate updates by fetching and parsing an XML feed from the European Central Bank (ECB). It is part of the OpenCart platform, specifically within the catalog extension controllers for currency management.

classes.name: ECB
classes.description: A controller class for handling currency exchange rate updates using ECB data, extending the core system controller.

methods.name: currency
methods.description: Fetches the latest currency exchange rates from the ECB XML feed, parses the XML, and updates the respective currency values in the system database.
